description: Waste processed by dehydrator at Degraves St Recycling Facility 2016 is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne open data portal (data.melbourne.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. The City of Melbourne operates a dehydrator for organic waste received at the Degraves Street Recycling Facility. This dataset records the amount of material processed, its incoming and outgoing weight each day of 2016. Coverage: City of Melbourne, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Its tags are dsrf, organic, recycling, waste, Environment. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
